name: Center of Ravnica
description: The historical, cultural and political heart of the city of Ravnica, a flattened mountaintop of exposed original surface.

description_citations.text: "Center of Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Boros general Ferrous Rokiric erects ten stone titans, placing Zobor in the Center to defend it.
timeline.quote: the Boros general Ferrous Rokiric erected ten stone titans to stand watch over the city in its defense

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Decamillennial, quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla attack the Center on Savra's orders.
timeline.quote: the Center was attacked by quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Golgari create a sinkhole that topples and shatters Zobor, also destroying the Tower of Thismi and damaging the Centerfort and Rokiric Pavilion.
timeline.quote: The Golgari created a massive sinkhole beneath him, causing the titan to topple and shatter across the surface of the mountain.

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Savra's death and Jarad's succession end the Golgari attack and force a withdrawal.
timeline.quote: Only the death of Savra and the succession of leadership to her brother, Jarad vod Savo , ultimately brought the Golgari attack to an end

citation.text: "Center of Ravnica", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
